clauses.clause: This creature gets +2/+2 as long as there are three or more land cards in your graveyard.
clauses.evidence: The standard graveyard (you_fallen, you_used) holds no land card, so the trace is always the printed 1/2 ('card on the battlefield: 1/2'). Tree: StaticAbility MODIFY_PT +2/+2 on IS_SOURCE, condition QTY_GE 3 over a count of Lands in Zone(GRAVEYARD, YOU). F08_1 (exactly three: 3/4), F08_2 (two own lands, a creature card and four opposing lands: 1/2), F08_3 (five: 3/4, not 5/6), F08_4 (one leaves the graveyard: back to 1/2).

clauses.clause: {2}, {T}, Sacrifice a land: Search your library for a land card, put it onto the battlefield tapped, then shuffle.
clauses.evidence: [activate [1] from battlefield]: 'card becomes tapped', 'you_land moves battlefield -> graveyard (by card/SACRIFICE)', 'you: mana C-2': the cost is paid as printed, but the filler library holds no land card, so the search finds nothing: no land enters, no shuffle shows. Tree: SEARCH 1 ONE_OF Land in Zone(LIBRARY, YOU) to Zone(BATTLEFIELD, YOU) tapped_on_enter, then SHUFFLE your library. F08_5 (the land is found and enters tapped, the sacrificed land goes to the graveyard, the library is shuffled), F08_6 (the sacrifice ask offers exactly your two lands), F08_7 (no land of yours: refused), F08_8 (only {1}: refused cost:mana_generic).
